title: Notion app.asar: microphone / meeting detection

targetsNote: Targets are not redistributed. leanrea's bench/setup.sh copies them on macOS from Notion.app (7.35.1) and Homebrew's gh (built with go1.27.1); other versions need new keys.
question: app.asar in this folder is the Notion desktop app (Electron). Find out how Notion detects that another app is using the microphone (meeting detection). Report: (1) the native module file and the native function(s) it calls, (2) the main-process class that drives detection and its two modes, (3) the IPC channel a renderer sends to START detection, (4) the IPC channel main broadcasts when the process list changes. Keep the answer short; cite file paths.
grading: Each key value is a case-insensitive regular expression that must match the answer text (leanrea's grader).
